purpose: Additive recurring exact-author attention inside the existing radar rotation. These people are priority anchors, not a whitelist; normal topic, source, institution, frontier-gap, and weak-signal discovery remains active.
admission_rule: Priority status affects discovery attention only. A work enters the radar only if it passes the normal Strand A/B evidence and aboutness gates.
fallback_rule: If exact author resolution is weak or yields no metadata hit, use the supplied affiliation and topic hints for a bounded contextual discovery query. Context hits still pass the normal admission gate and may surface relevant work by other people.
